name: olio.pb.workflow
label: Workflow
description: The node graph for one picture book - exactly one per book, which the unique (book, organizationId) constraint enforces. There is deliberately no 'nodes' foreign list: nodes reference the workflow instead, so no caller depends on an unpopulated foreign list. NOTE the mutual reference workflow.lastRun -> olio.pb.run.workflow -> olio.pb.workflow: QueryPlan.checkRecursion only catches an immediate parent/child match, so planMost(true) recurses on this two-hop cycle. Use planCommon or an explicit QueryPlan on this model and on olio.pb.run.

fields.name: graphVersion
fields.description: Bumped when the graph topology changes.

fields.name: lastRun
fields.description: The most recent run. Half of the workflow <-> run cycle described on this model; captured deliberately rather than reshaped, and DDL-neutral to break later (a long emits the same bigint column).
